response.overview: A film following a man documenting the mysterious appearance of horseshoe crabs along the shorelines of the coastal island where he lives. As the infestation spreads, strange effigies appear among the debris-strewn beaches and cliffs, and the crabs themselves gradually seep into the everyday life of the island. He gathers video evidence while developing his own theories about what is happening; the phenomenon could be an ecological warning, a collective delusion, or a hoax. The line between documentation, belief, and delusion starts to crumble. What begins as something otherworldly gradually becomes rumour, then a product, and eventually just another part of everyday life.
response.title: CRABS
